name: Zotye Automobile Co., Ltd
summary: Zotye Automobile Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of automobiles in China and internationally. It offers car, SUV, MPV, and new energy vehicles. The company also designs, develops, and manufactures components, including engines, transmissions, batteries, motors, and electronic controls; and provides customer support, after-sales services, spare parts, and warranty and maintenance services. The company sells car, SUV, MPV, new energy vehicle, and other sub markets. It exports its products to Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, the United Arab Emirates, Mongolia, Bolivia, and internationally.
